Lemma
[distance distortion under Ricci flow] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 3.4.1\group Cao–Zhu No Local Collapsing Theorem II Let $g_{ij}(x,t)$ be a solution to the Ricci flow on an $n$-dimensional manifold $M$ and denote by $d_t(x,x_0)$ the distance between $x$ and $x_0$ with respect to the metric $g_{ij}(t)$.

  • Suppose $\Ric (\cdot ,t_0)\leq (n-1)K$ on $B_{t_0}(x_0,r_0)$ for some $x_0\in M$ and some positive constants K and $r_0$. Then the distance function $d(x,t)=d_t(x,x_0)$ satisfies, at $t=t_0$ and outside $B_{t_0}(x_0,r_0)$, the differential inequality:

    \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}d-\Delta d \geq -(n-1)\left(\frac{2}{3}Kr_0+r_0^{-1}\right). \]

  • Suppose $\Ric (\cdot ,t_0)\leq (n-1)K$ on $B_{t_0}(x_0,r_0)\bigcup B_{t_0}(x_1,r_0)$ for some $x_0,x_1\in M$ and some positive constants K and $r_0$. Then, at $t=t_0$,

    \[ \frac{d}{dt}d_t(x_0,x_1)\geq -2(n-1)\left(\frac{2}{3}Kr_0+r_0^{-1}\right). \]

Proof
